$description: Motion tokens. Springs are expressed as physical parameters (stiffness/damping/mass) so the same values drive both the web prototypes and the native VCL animator; the build also emits a solved cubic-bezier + duration approximation for CSS-only consumers.

snappy.$description: Default for controls: buttons, toggles, tabs. Settles in ~180ms with no visible overshoot.

smooth.$description: Panels and sheets. Slightly softer landing.

bouncy.$description: Elements that gain focus and should feel physical — the command palette, a dialog appearing. Small, deliberate overshoot.

gentle.$description: Large-surface transitions: workspace view changes, focus-mode entry.

transition.$description: Named CSS transitions. Pair a duration with an easing; components should not invent combinations.

distance.$description: How far an element travels on enter/exit. Nova keeps travel short — motion communicates origin, it is not the effect.

scale.$description: Enter/exit scale endpoints. Never scale from 0 — it reads as a cartoon.

reduced-motion.$description: Values substituted when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set. Transitions collapse to a near-instant opacity change; transforms are dropped entirely by the motion package.
